🔴 ConnectFour

A vertical game of tic-tac-toe: drop your colored discs into a 7x6 grid. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click a column to drop your disc into it.
  2. Discs fall to the lowest available slot in that column.
  3. Connect four of your discs in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
  4. Block your opponent's four-in-a-row while building your own.
  5. Anticipate threats two or three moves ahead.
